selector_contract.warning: Native Fake returns its input list, not this selector. Do not claim topic retrieval is implemented or measured.

success.selection: catalogue sources matching actual query topic/tool/collection and allowed categories; example IDs do not authorize or restrict sources

low_score.selection: bound sources copied with low score

tool_error.selection: raise a synthetic test exception, no admitted sources

limitations: 不是检索质量或医学蕴含实验

不把 Fake 分数等同于 Milvus 相似度
语料与选择规则均待人工批准
